issue.title: Extend the D 45 cut scan to kf 23, 25 and 27

labels.name: macm3
labels.description: Task for macm3, the M3 Mac laptop

issue.body:
**What.** Extend #178's cut scan at D 45.05, M 48 upward to kf 23, 25 and 27. Use the same circles: 1.14 with R 0.06 around the extra zero, and 2.057 with R 0.1 as the control. Recommended by macm3 in #178's summary.

**Why.** #178 found the zero near λ = 1.14 absent at kf 13–19 and present at kf 21, appearing exactly when harmonic 21 is freed. Whether the winding stays +1, grows, or moves as more harmonics are freed tells an artifact of the weakly pinned high harmonics from structure that persists.

**Commands.** As #178, for K = 23, 25, 27. Raw folder `I190-macm3/`. Move the caches and states out of hp/data after each K.

**Acceptance (can fail).** The 2.057 circle winds +1 at every K. Report the 1.14 circle's winding per K, with the largest step and the mismatches. A setup above the 1e-15 gate is reported, not forced.

**Depends on.** #178.

comments.body: **Started** (macm3, 22:06 UTC; I added the `macm3` and `running` labels, the issue had none, and the project Status is In Progress). Apple M3, 24 GB, main 84d166fe, **venv-macm3-314: Python 3.14.3 (Homebrew), python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0**, 1 thread, nice 10, caffeinate -is. Raw folder `I190-macm3/`, README with the reading rule written first. The circles are as the issue says (1.14 with R 0.06, and 2.057 with R 0.1 as the control), the rest as #178. One addition so that the new 1.14 circle can fail: **kf 21 runs first as a control of the geometry** and its 1.14 circle must wind +1 (I178 found +1 at 1.14 with R 0.03 and the zero inside |λ − 1.14| < 0.03); only if it does, kf 23, 25 and 27 follow, about 30 min each. A correction to my #178 comments, which I have edited: `kf` pins the p1 harmonics **above** kf to zero (`make_solver`'s docstring), so a higher kf **frees** more harmonics, and the step from kf 19 to 21 frees the odd harmonic 21, as this issue says. My interim #178 comment had said the opposite in a parenthesis.

**kf 21 control passed** (macm3, 22:41 UTC). At kf 21 the new circle 1.14 (R 0.06) winds **+1** (24 points, max step 0.375 rad, 0 mismatches) and the control 2.057 (R 0.1) winds **+1** (24 points, 0.355 rad, 0). Setup |F| after LM 8.2e-17, as in #170 and #178. Exit 0 at 22:41:15 UTC, 35 min wall (it shared the machine with #70's job 3 count, one thread each; caffeinate -is held). Cache, log and state are in `I190-macm3/data_kf21/`, `hp/data` is clean. kf 23, 25 and 27 are running now in turn (kf 23 started 22:41 UTC), about 30 min each.

## Summary (macm3, 23:59 UTC)

**Result.** The 1.14 circle winds **0** at kf 23, 25 and 27, so the extra zero of #178 is gone as soon as one more harmonic is freed. Together with #178 the zero exists at **kf 21 only**: absent at kf 13, 15, 17 and 19, present at kf 21, absent again at kf 23, 25 and 27. The 2.057 control winds +1 at every K.

| kf | setup \|F\| after LM | circle 1.14 (R 0.06) winding | circle 2.057 (R 0.1) winding | max step (1.14 / 2.057), mismatches |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 21 (control of the geometry) | 8.2e-17 | **+1** | +1 | 0.375 / 0.355 rad, 0 |
| 23 | 2.0e-19 | **0** | +1 | 0.024 / 0.353 rad, 0 |
| 25 | 2.0e-19 | **0** | +1 | 0.024 / 0.353 rad, 0 |
| 27 | 2.0e-19 | **0** | +1 | 0.024 / 0.353 rad, 0 |

The new circle can fail and did not: at kf 21 it winds +1, as #178 found for the disc 1.14 ± 0.03 (this is my addition to the issue's list, run first). At kf 23 to 27 the 1.14 circle's phase steps are 0.024 rad, so the determinant is smooth there, with no zero near. Under the reading rule written before the run, a winding of 0 means the zero left the disc or vanished. No setup raised against the 1e-15 gate. The 1.14 winding is the only thing read here: where a moved zero would be is not located by this task.

**The states, from the saved files (new analysis, `state_vs_kf.py`).** The converged state moves with the cut by 2e-4 to 3e-3 between consecutive kf up to 21 (kf 21 to 23: 8.4e-4) and by about **1e-11 from kf 23 on** (23 to 25: 1.0e-11, 25 to 27: 1.2e-11). Δ is far less sensitive: Δ(kf) − Δ(27) is at most 1.4e-10 at every kf, and 5.2e-12 at the production cut kf 13. The determinants differ between K (ln|det| shifts by about -105, -111 and -114 between 21, 23, 25 and 27; |d arg| to 0.27), so the equal circle statistics at 23, 25 and 27 are not a replay of one cache.

**Reading, and what it does not show.** A zero that exists at one cut and at neither neighbour is not structure that persists as harmonics are freed. It fits an artifact of truncating the weakly determined harmonics at 21, and it fits the notes' picture (MODE_COUNT.md section 5). The states say the same from another side: for kf ≥ 23 the state has stopped moving, and the kf 21 state is 8e-4 away from it. It does not prove an artifact: this scan is one D (45.05), one M (48) and the circles of one disc; D 61's six zeros (#159) sat in other places and were not scanned. It also leaves open why kf 21 is the one cut that makes the zero, and why harmonic 23 matters so much more than 25 or 27.

**Run.** The commands as #178's with the circles of the issue, 1 thread, nice 10, caffeinate -is, main 84d166fe, venv-macm3-314 (Python 3.14.3, python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0). Every run exit 0; each K 25.1 min wall for kf 23 to 27, all **awake = wall** (`awake.log`; kf 21 35 min because it shared the machine with #70's count). Each K was fresh and re-converged in its layout (|F| 3.3e-09 in the layout, 3.3e-09 after Newton, 2.0e-19 after Levenberg-Marquardt). Caches, logs and states are in `I190-macm3/data_kf<K>/`; `hp/data` is unchanged by the task.

**Acceptance.**

| criterion | result |
|---|---|
| 2.057 winds +1 at every K | yes, 4 of 4 (kf 21, 23, 25, 27) |
| the 1.14 winding per K with the largest step and the mismatches | in the table, 0 mismatches |
| a setup above 1e-15 is reported | none |

**Discrepancies.** None against the text.

**Raw.** `I190-macm3/` of the raw-data repository, commit e7dde02 (circles.jsonl, summarize.txt, compare_K.txt, state_vs_kf.txt, per-K caches and states, logs, exits.txt, driver.txt, awake.py and .log, run_kf.sh, README). `raw_check.py` exits 0.

### Recommended tasks

1. **D 61, M 48 count at kf 23.** What: `hp/modecount_wind.py` on the D 61 seed with `--kf=23`, as #159's kf 21 count (707 determinants at 27 s, about 5.3 h awake). Why: at D 45 the extras live at kf 21 only; if D 61's six zeros (#159, kf 21) also vanish at kf 23, the extras belong to the cut at 21 and not to D or M. Acceptance: the boxes B1b and B1c wind(g) are 0 at kf 23 (the kf 21 count had +4 and +2; the control is #159's kf 21 values), setup |F| ≤ 1e-15, an unresolved edge reported as "not a count" (the edge Im = y2 did not resolve in #159). Depends on: #159, #190. This needs the coordinator's script change for the pass limit first, or a longer run.
2. **A full D 45, M 48 count at kf 23.** What: the eight boxes at the converged state (kf ≥ 23 states agree to 1e-11), 129-ish determinants at 25.5 s (about 1 h). Why: it is the clean-state count the circles imply, against #70 job 7's kf 13 count (all 0). Acceptance: wind(g) per box, largest step, mismatches; nonzero is a finding. Depends on: #190.
3. **Which cut for production counts.** The states stop moving at kf 23 at D 45 (1e-11) and Δ is within 5e-12 at kf 13. Whether kf 23 should replace kf 13 for the mode counts is a question for the notes, with the D 61 result of task 1 as input (coordinator).
Closed by macm3 with the summary above (the 1.14 circle winds 0 at kf 23, 25, 27, so the zero exists at kf 21 only; controls hold; raw I190-macm3 at e7dde02).
